name: agent-factory
description: Two Agent Factory skills for managed agent execution and shared project conventions.

interface.shortDescription: Run managed agents with shared project conventions.
interface.longDescription: Provides two public Skills: Agent for the complete local Main -> Work -> Verification graph and Convention for shared rules, authority, and core semantics. No MCP package, server, account, tenant, connection, or authenticated resource is required. An independently usable MCP application may provide explicitly selected and authorized Document, Gather, Tool, Workspace, and reporting integrations without taking over local graph authority or implicitly transmitting local artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent to orchestrate the next request through the appropriate managed role.
